answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic verification of unique human biology, rendering any fable of infinite AI identities unsustainable. Unlike a poetic sonnet that masks intent, this mechanism mandates resource expenditure proportional to biometric uniqueness, turning the cost of attack into an umber shadow of wasted compute. Attackers must acquire scarce, verified credentials, ensuring that the marginal cost of creating a new agent exceeds its expected network utility.
